about: KOSH's ILS RWY 36 (I36, via OSH and from vectors), LOC RWY 36 (L36) and RNAV (GPS) RWY 36 (R36) as the planner draws them from the CIFP of 29 Oct 2026 with the CIFP's own figures (wingtip.procedures.procedure_drawing, wingtip.approach_facts; TDZE from NASR), and the tags the engine's approach_fix_tags answers for each. The plate: ILS or LOC RWY 36, Amdt 7D: POBER at or above 2,700, GS 2,610; CFBSM 2,700; TCH 53, TDZE 809; missed approach to LEWKO and hold at 3,000.
